fills.researcher_notes: ONE QUESTION PER COMPANY, answered once and applied across all 5 rows in this brief: intergas.kz's own corporate-structure page (both RU and EN versions of the same publisher -- not two independent origins, hence tier=medium not high) lists Intergas Central Asia JSC's regional operating divisions (Управления магистральных газопроводов / UMG branches). The EN page states verbatim under 'Aktobe Branch': 'Bukhara - Ural MGP; Zhanazhol - Oktyabrsk - Aktobe gas pipeline with loopings', and under 'Kostanay Branch': 'Bukhara - Ural MGP; Kartaly - Rudnyi - Kostanay MGP' -- i.e. Intergas Central Asia operates MG Bukhara-Ural within Kazakhstan via TWO of its own UMG divisions (Aktobe and Kostanay), consistent with this system's two parallel mainline strings terminating in different Russian oblasts via different Kazakh regions. Per the protocol's transit-corridor guidance, this fill names the entity that operates the KAZAKH section specifically -- P2289 runs Gazli (Uzbekistan) -> Chelyabinsk (Russia) via Kazakhstan, so 'Intergas Central Asia' answers only the Kazakh-transit leg of this row's Operator question, not the Uzbek or Russian legs (no source found for those, and none was sought -- out of scope per protocol). This is NOT the wiki's naive union ('Gazprom, Turkmengaz, Uztransgaz, Intergas Central Asia') copied wholesale; it is independently sourced and scoped to the Kazakh section only. Value formatted to match this tracker's existing convention for the same entity elsewhere on the Kazakh gas roster (e.g. P3273 Beineu-Bozoy-Shymkent, P3964 Almaty-Taldykorgan both read plain 'Intergas Central Asia', no legal-form suffix).
